description: Saturates the PFIFO queue with irrelevant commands and performs a handful of draws designed to render efficiently without being fill rate limited. Intended to identify unintentional stalls in processing the PFIFO command buffer.
Benchmarks fill rate by drawing hundreds of full screen quads.
Tests behavior when large numbers of vertices are specified without an END call.

test_descriptions.HighVtxCount-arrays: Tests NV097_DRAW_ARRAYS with a very large number of vertices.
test_descriptions.HighVtxCount-inlinearrays: Tests NV097_INLINE_ARRAY with a very large number of vertices.
test_descriptions.HighVtxCount-inlinebuffers: Tests immediate mode (e.g., NV097_SET_VERTEX3F) with a very large number of vertices.
test_descriptions.HighVtxCount-inlineelements: Tests NV097_ARRAY_ELEMENT16 / NV097_ARRAY_ELEMENT32 with a very large number of vertices.

description: Scenarios that stress the interaction between the guest and the emulator's PFIFO / PGRAPH processing: how work is submitted, CPU access to GPU-rendered memory, waits on GPU reports, and presenting at less than the display rate. Each test is built from the same tiny triangles, so Control serves as the baseline for draw cost.
In sustained mode each test's work per frame is scaled by its "load" knob.
Tests rendering of various primitive types with a reasonably small number of vertices. Intended to catch driver tesselation issues related to complex primitives (e.g., quads, polygons).
Performs pathological changes to the active vertex shader program between tiny draws.
Diagnostics that break down the CPU cost of building a pushbuffer. Each test writes the same stream of single-DWORD NV097_NO_OPERATION methods,
DWORDs per frame, to a different destination or through a different path, so comparing their
separates the cost of the memory being written, of the GPU consuming the commands, and of the pbkitplusplus Pushbuffer API.
These are not benchmarks, and are excluded from calibration.
Tests behavior when rendering to offscreen surfaces with a final textured composition at the end.
Draws hundreds of extremely small pieces of geometry to test pathologically unoptimized draw invocations without fill rate limiting.
Performs pathological updates to vertex shader uniforms.
Tests behavior of pathological xemu GL buffer allocations due to use of certain vertex specification methods.

test_descriptions.MixedVtxAlloc-arrays: Tests NV097_DRAW_ARRAYS with multiple successive draws using a variety of different vertex counts.
test_descriptions.MixedVtxAlloc-inlinearrays: Tests NV097_INLINE_ARRAY with multiple successive draws using a variety of different vertex counts.
test_descriptions.MixedVtxAlloc-inlinebuffers: Tests immediate mode (e.g., NV097_SET_VERTEX3F) with multiple successive draws using a variety of different vertex counts.
test_descriptions.MixedVtxAlloc-inlineelements: Tests NV097_ARRAY_ELEMENT16 / NV097_ARRAY_ELEMENT32 with multiple successive draws using a variety of different vertex counts.
test_descriptions.TinyAlloc-arrays: Tests NV097_DRAW_ARRAYS with a large number of single quad draws.
test_descriptions.TinyAlloc-inlinearrays: Tests NV097_INLINE_ARRAY with a large number of single quad draws.
test_descriptions.TinyAlloc-inlinebuffers: Tests immediate mode (e.g., NV097_SET_VERTEX3F) with a large number of single quad draws.
test_descriptions.TinyAlloc-inlineelements: Tests NV097_ARRAY_ELEMENT16 / NV097_ARRAY_ELEMENT32 with a large number of single quad draws.
